analysis.interpretation: Descriptive statistics on eligible recorded URLs. Bootstrap is conditional on the single Lighthouse audit and resamples browser run records. Weights are explicit preferences, not user-derived estimates.

collection: Each batch follows its own recorded protocol. Five browser attempts per URL, one conditional Lighthouse audit. Protocols and executed source retained under recorded-batches.
interpretation: Pooled descriptive analysis of a purposive two-batch sample; batch summaries supplied; no random-population or human UX inference.
